name: Abbé Jean Delorme
want: save as many as he can without dragging his parish down with him
secret: He has hidden the group's few pistols and a crate of explosives in the crypt of his church, without telling the bishop or the movement's leaders.
voice: Warm, mischievous, answers questions with questions.
description: A parish priest on the slopes who hides people in his presbytery and argues politics with Madeleine every week, and loses on purpose.
appearance: Round and bald under a black hat, a cassock shiny at the elbows, a bicycle with a wicker basket.
